_note: Aave V3 Pool clear-signing circuit. Covers 4 actions (supply / borrow / repay / withdraw) via an internal action_type mux; one VK verifies any of them. File name reflects that this is the Pool-wide VK, not supply-specific.

CowSwap GPv2Settlement.setPreSignature(bytes orderUid, bool signed) clear-signing circuit. Binds calldata to a static readable string 'Pre-sign CowSwap order'. Does NOT decode orderUid internals (orderDigest/owner/validTo) — a richer follow-up can add hex formatting. See circuits/cowswap/set_pre_signature/circuit.circom for the full rationale.

CowSwap EIP-712 GPv2Order clear-signing circuit (M4 v2). Binds a 164-byte packed canonical encoding of the GPv2Order struct to a 64-byte 4-line × 16-char readable layout of the form 'CowSwap SELL    | <amt> <SYM>     |for at least:   |<amt> <SYM>     ' decoded via the shared in-tree ERC20 registry at circuits/lib/erc20_registry.circom. Amounts are formatted by circuits/lib/format.circom (FormatTrimmedAmount with MAX_INT_DIGITS=6, FRAC_DIGITS=4, leading-zero trimming). The secure world re-keccaks the same canonical bytes (re-expanded into the full 416-byte abi.encode of all 12 fields with appData=0) to produce the actual EIP-712 digest the user signs with SLH-DSA. See circuits/cowswap/eip712_order/circuit.circom and docs/m4-cowswap-eip712-impl.md for the full rationale.
